# `oaap authz`

business authorization -- roles, collections, assignments (oaap.core.authorization).

**Root:** needs `sudo`.

## Usage

```sh
oaap authz {declarations,roles,role-add,collections,collection-add,assignments,assign,revoke,mappings,map-add,map-remove,role-retire,collection-retire,setup,agent-add} [name] [options]
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `verb` | (one of `declarations`, `roles`, `role-add`, `collections`, `collection-add`, `assignments`, `assign`, `revoke`, `mappings`, `map-add`, `map-remove`, `role-retire`, `collection-retire`, `setup`, `agent-add`) |
| `name` | for 'revoke' / 'map-remove' / 'role-retire' / 'collection-retire': the id (or its first characters; a name for the last two); for 'agent-add': the agent's name |
| `--instance INSTANCE` | for agent-add: the one instance its key is limited to |
| `--days DAYS` | for agent-add: how long the key is valid (1-365, default 90) |
| `--label LABEL` | for agent-add: what this agent is for |
| `--group GROUP` | for map-add: the group's path in the realm, e.g. Verein/Hallenwart |
| `--tenant TENANT` | the tenant's label |
| `--app APP` | -- |
| `--template TEMPLATE` | -- |
| `--name ITEM_NAME` | the role's or collection's name |
| `--value FIELD=ID[,ID]` | for role-add: fill a $value field (ids, not labels) (repeatable) |
| `--role ROLE` | for collection-add: a role name or id, repeatable |
| `--collection COLLECTION` | -- |
| `--user USER` | a user NAME of the tenant (stored by id, RFC-0040); for assign: who receives the collection, for assignments: list only this user's |
| `--context FIELD=TWIN-ID` | for assign: fill a $context field (repeatable) |
| `--from DATE` | -- |
| `--to DATE` | -- |
| `--only KEY[,KEY]` | for setup: only these templates |
| `--skip KEY[,KEY]` | for setup: leave these templates out |
| `--group-for KEY=PATH` | for setup: the group path for a template (overrides the manifest's suggestion), repeatable |
| `--name-for KEY=NAME` | for setup: the name of the role and the collection for a template, instead of its title (the way out of a name that is taken), repeatable |
| `--no-groups` | for setup: do not make the groups in the realm; the mappings are still written |
| `--dry-run` | for setup: print the plan, change nothing |
| `--accept-version ACCEPT_VERSION` | for setup: the provider's version, as the operator's word, when the connector cannot read it |
